title: DF Provenance Header — self-describing metadata atop each generated artifact
description: A header mixin composed into each persisted artifact (it sits beside the artifact body, e.g. `units`). Conceptually DF-core: every aspect's artifacts carry it. Not standalone-strict — additionalProperties is intentionally open so the body can be added alongside.

source-sha.description: git blob SHA (content hash) of the analyzed source file, whole-file. Obtain via `git hash-object <path>` — hashes the working-tree bytes actually analyzed (not `rev-parse HEAD:<path>`, which would record the committed version). The content half of the (source-sha x config-id) dedupe key.

config.description: Extensible run-parameter bag. `id` is the short dedupe handle; other keys (model, approach, ...) are open-ended.

id.description: Short config handle; the config half of the dedupe key.
